To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the use of co-occurrence information in combination with the use of a dictionary of sentiment words is a promising direction to tackle the aspect level sentiment analysis task.

(1) the combination of a dictionary based sentiment analysis and a co-occurrences based category detection algorithm yields a very competitive performance, (2) the category detection algorithm can also be used to detect aspects and (3) the category detection method is robust to noise in the data.

a co-occurence based approach can be used to detect categories and to classify the sentiment of a sentence.
